_doc: Terms the translation keeps fixed. `keep` stays as written in every language; `translations` imposes a word per language; `tone` is the register of each language.

credit.de: Guthaben (a balance), Credit / Credits (a count: "500 Credits")

issue.de: Ticket (a work item of a project; never Aufgabe, which names a coworker's scheduled task)

tone.de: Duzen (du), as recent German SaaS products do. Short, plain product German; nouns capitalized. No anglicisms beyond the glossary.

rules: Never use the em dash (—) nor the en dash as punctuation.
Keep every ICU argument ({name}, {count, plural, ...}) and every rich text tag (<link>...</link>) exactly as in the source.
Translate the words inside plural and select branches, and give every plural category the target language needs.
Stay as short as the English: a button label stays a button label.
